behavior: host setup/check emit a descriptor carrying the detected port (45000 case, not 3389)
importing a descriptor yields a profile whose target uses the descriptor's port; connect --profile dials it
verification: go test ./cmd/cli/... -run TestRunImport_WritesProfile && go test ./cmd/cli/... -run TestApplyProfile_ResolvesTargetFromStore

behavior: descriptor round-trips losslessly (parse(emit(x))==x) incl. version; malformed input errors without panic
backward compatibility: existing TS_TARGET=host:port keeps working with no profile present
cross-platform emission: buildDescriptorLine is OS-agnostic; test runs on all platforms
control-plane parity: a descriptor with cp=<Headscale URL> imports and connects identically to cp=saas
idempotent import: importing the same descriptor twice yields a single, uncorrupted profile
.env.example, README, and docs/ document the import flow and discover --port behavior
